ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white high-intensity fields occupy the majority of both lateral lobes. A central low-intensity black region is localized around the median notch and extends towards the peduncle. Two distinct, non-contiguous dark elliptical blobs are located in the upper-right white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 110 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-20 pixels; more pronounced jagged peaks on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe compared to the finer, more uniform serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward convexity fitted to both lobes, with the trailing edge curving significantly toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct dark-on-white circular pixel clusters in the upper quadrant of the right lobe; sparse high-contrast white spotting on the black margins of the lower left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the central black pigmentation and extending into the medial white regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks across the central-ventral surface and minor physical irregularities along the trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pair of horizontally aligned dark spots within the upper white field of the right lobe lobe.
